name: Kylie Suarez
source:
Young and precocious, little Kylie is the picture of sweet innocence and is a Year Five Prep student at St. Goretti High. Her father is a successful business man who makes sure she gets what she wants. She frequently visits Miss Gales' class, having an older brother in her class, and is quick to tattle an talk.

[From [url=https://www.castingcall.club/projects/paid-see-submission-guidelines-the-letter-a-horror-visual-novel]Castingcall.club[/url]]
